Maria Rambeau's KitchenCaptain MarvelCrash landing. Snack stop.Every recipe serves 4.

    StartersVideo store brown butter parmesan popcornPopcorn tossed with nutty brown butter and parmesan saltHow to make it120g popcorn kernels3 tbsp vegetable oil80g butter40g parmesan, finely grated1 tsp sea salt flakes1 tsp rosemary leavesHeat the oil and kernels in a big lidded pot over medium-high heat, shaking until the popping slows.Cook the butter in a small pan until golden brown and nutty.Blitz the salt with the rosemary.Toss the popcorn with the brown butter, parmesan and rosemary salt and serve in big tubs.Goose's fish bitesPanko crusted salmon pieces baked golden, with tartar sauce to dipHow to make it600g salmon fillet, skin off50g plain flour2 eggs, beaten100g panko breadcrumbs1 tbsp oil spray or oil120g tartare sauceCut the salmon into bite-sized pieces.Dust in flour, dip in egg and press into the panko.Spread on a lined tray, spray with a little oil and bake at 220°C until golden.Serve with tartare sauce. Keep them away from the cat.MainsMaria's Louisiana gumboDark roux gumbo with chicken, smoked sausage and okra, served over riceHow to make it60g plain flour60ml vegetable oil1 brown onion, diced1 green capsicum, diced2 celery sticks, diced600g chicken thigh fillets, chopped300g smoked sausage, sliced200g okra, sliced1.5 L water300g long grain riceStir the flour into the oil over medium heat until it turns dark brown.Add the onion, capsicum and celery and soften.Add the chicken, sausage, okra and water and simmer until rich and thick.Cook the rice and serve the gumbo over it.Rambeau family honey butter fried chickenButtermilk fried chicken with hot honey butter, at Maria's tableHow to make it1kg chicken thigh fillets300ml buttermilk200g plain flour2 tsp sweet paprika1 tsp garlic powder1 tsp cayenne pepper1 L vegetable oil, for frying60g butter3 tbsp honey1 tsp hot sauceSoak the chicken in the buttermilk with a big pinch of salt for at least 1 hour.Mix the flour with the paprika, garlic powder, half the cayenne and salt. Dredge the chicken, dip back in buttermilk and dredge again.Fry in oil at 170°C, a few pieces at a time, until deep golden and cooked through.Melt the butter with the honey, hot sauce and the rest of the cayenne and brush over the hot chicken.SweetsPhoton blast pieTart lemon filling in a sweet crust under glossy meringueHow to make it2 sheets of sweet shortcrust pastry4 lemons350g caster sugar4 tbsp cornflour4 eggs, separated60g butterBlind bake a pastry case at 180°C.Separate the eggs. Whisk the lemon juice and zest, a portion of the sugar, cornflour, egg yolks and butter over heat until thick, and pour into the case.Whisk the egg whites with the remaining sugar to glossy peaks and pile on top.Bake at 200°C until the meringue is golden.Drinks1995 fuzzy navel slushiesFrozen peach and orange slush with peach schnapps, or a no-alcohol swapHow to make it300g frozen peach slices500ml orange juice160ml peach schnapps1 lime2 cups ice4 maraschino cherries4 orange wheelsBlend the peaches, orange juice, schnapps, lime juice and ice until thick and slushy.Pour into chilled glasses and top each with a cherry and an orange wheel.
